insights.one_liner: LEMON search is a small Amsterdam recruiter for finance professionals, placing people in roles around €70k-€100k, and an IND visa sponsor.

culture.text: A small team of about 14 people in Amsterdam, with backgrounds in communication, business and media from schools like Hotelschool The Hague and Amsterdam UAS.
Coaches and recruits finance talent for roles like controller, ESG controller, M&A analyst and BI, working alongside sister firm LIME for CFOs.
Its one open job is a senior finance role in Amsterdam, averaging 86 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Lemon Solutions B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Its roles target people on their second or third career step, with base salaries of about €70k to €100k.
